units.source_text: 我们俩晒得黑黝黝的回到了东京。

en.t: The two of us returned to Tokyo deeply tanned by the sun.

units.source_text: 回来后，我的心情又变了，什么有人情味没有人情味的，这套说词在我脑子里已经踪影全无。

en.t: After we came back, my mood changed again, and all that talk about being humane or inhumane had vanished completely from my mind.

units.source_text: K脸上那种教徒似的神情也完全消失不见了，那时他的头脑里恐怕已没有灵与肉问题的栖身之地。

en.t: The believer-like expression on K's face had also disappeared entirely; by then, there was probably no place left in his mind for questions of spirit and flesh.

units.source_text: 我们就像是外乡人似的左顾右盼地瞧着繁华的东京。

en.t: Like strangers from out of town, we looked left and right at bustling Tokyo.

units.source_text: 之后我们去了两国，不顾暑热天气，吃了一顿暹罗鸡。

en.t: After that we went to Ryogoku and, despite the summer heat, ate a meal of shamo chicken.

units.source_text: K趁着这个势头，建议干脆走回小石川吧。

en.t: Carried along by the momentum, K suggested that we might as well walk back to Koishikawa.

units.source_text: 论体力，我要比K强些，马上同意了。

en.t: In terms of physical strength, I was a little stronger than K, so I agreed at once.

units.source_text: 到家的时候，夫人看到我们两个的模样大为吃惊。

en.t: When we arrived home, Madam was greatly surprised to see the state the two of us were in.

units.source_text: 两个人不仅晒得黝黑，加上走了很多路，都瘦了不少。

en.t: Not only had both of us become darkly tanned, but after walking so much we had also lost a good deal of weight.

units.source_text: 不过夫人还是称赞说，瞧着更结实了。

en.t: Even so, Madam praised us, saying that we looked sturdier.

units.source_text: 小姐说夫人说话自相矛盾，真可笑，说完又吃吃地笑起来。

en.t: The young lady said Madam was contradicting herself and that it was funny; then she giggled again.

units.source_text: 去旅行之前，我常常为小姐无端发笑而生气，此时却觉得很愉快。

en.t: Before the trip, I had often been irritated by the young lady's laughing for no reason, but at that moment I found it very pleasant.

units.source_text: 大概是因为今天的场合不同，况且很久没听到这笑声的缘故吧。

en.t: Perhaps it was because the occasion was different that day, and also because it had been so long since I had heard that laughter.
1. Ryogoku: a place name in Tokyo.
